svg.title: DFD — Notification system with static events and dynamic recipient resolution
svg.desc: Events are hardcoded per program. Only recipient resolution is dynamic via query-based logic. New recipient groups can be added by admin.
svg.text: A — Static program-event catalog (hardcoded, no UI changes)

svg.text: D — Dynamic recipient resolution (query-based, system-defined, not user-changeable)
